business: The Corporate Law and Legal Compliance Group
summary: A Middle East business law group with offices in Dubai and Riyadh appears to lose enquiries to a free builder address, a menu typo and a 2017 footer.

findings.problem: The menu appears to read CORPORATE RESPOSIBILITY.
findings.cost: A spelling error in the main menu of a compliance firm weakens trust.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes an international firm look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the site is not kept up to date.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: The Riyadh and Bahrain offices appear to list the same phone number.
findings.cost: Clients dialing the wrong office may give up.
findings.fix: A correct number for each office.

redesign: Current footer and correct office numbers.
